## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. The listing gives its length as 1 hours, over a route of about 3.0 km. It starts at Brooklands Museum, Brooklands Dr, Weybridge KT13 0SL, UK. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Brooklands Museum. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Embark on an adventure that invites the curious to delve into the rich tapestry of transportation history. Included with your ticket, start at the Brooklands Museum in London, a treasure trove of classic race cars and iconic aircraft such as the legendary Concorde. This self-guided audio tour is tailored for enthusiasts of all ages with a passion for exploring the past on your own terms, smartphone in hand.
>
> The journey begins at Brooklands Museum, guiding you up the famous Test Hill and through the Garden Of Memories. You’ll then move to the London Bus Museum for a glimpse into the evolution of public transport. Next, embrace the calm of the St Charles Borromeo Church before heading back to experience the supersonic allure of Concorde. The route will then take you to Mercedes-Benz World to marvel at luxurious automobiles and concludes at Brooklands Community Park, providing a serene finale to your day of discovery.
>
> Throughout this excursion, the most memorable moments include standing beside the Concorde, feeling the innovation at Mercedes-Benz World, and enjoying the tranquility of Brooklands Community Park. Please note that while the ticket to Brooklands Museum is included, an audio tour inside is not provided, ensuring the focus remains on your personal experience as you navigate each stop with the stories and facts provided in the app.
